title: Calligraphy: Wang Xizhi and the Orchid Pavilion Preface
description: A course-authoring example for adding culturally specific calligraphy content through the admin upload API.

lessons.title: Reading 行书 as Movement
lessons.summary: Use the Orchid Pavilion Preface to connect Chinese text, cultural gathering, and brush rhythm.
lessons.body_simplified: 《兰亭集序》表现了书法的节奏、聚会的雅趣和时间的感叹。王羲之的行书让文字像水一样流动。
lessons.body_traditional: 《蘭亭集序》表現了書法的節奏、聚會的雅趣和時間的感嘆。王羲之的行書讓文字像水一樣流動。
lessons.pinyin: Lántíng jí xù biǎoxiàn le shūfǎ de jiézòu, jùhuì de yǎqù hé shíjiān de gǎntàn.

flashcards.prompt: Which work is associated with Wang Xizhi?
flashcards.answer: 兰亭集序 / 蘭亭集序
